introTitle: Launch your Moroccan beauty brand with our factory
introParagraphs: Moroccan Cosmetics Wholesale is a manufacturer, wholesaler, and exporter based in Marrakesh. We help brands, spas, and distributors create private label lines using authentic Moroccan ingredients and export-ready quality standards.
From single hero SKUs to full hammam and skincare collections, we combine traditional know-how with modern production — so you can sell under your name without building a factory from scratch.

productsIntro: These wholesale SKUs are frequently private labeled for retail, spa, and e-commerce collections.

faq.question: What is private label Moroccan cosmetics manufacturing?
faq.answer: Private label means we produce Moroccan cosmetics under your brand — with your packaging and identity — while you benefit from our factory, ingredients, and export infrastructure in Marrakesh.

faq.question: Which products can I private label?
faq.answer: Most of our wholesale range is available for private label, including argan oil, prickly pear seed oil, black soap, ghassoul clay, nila powder, aker fassi, rose water, and curated spa ritual sets.

faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: MOQ typically starts at 50 pieces depending on the product type, bottle size, and label run. Contact us for exact terms on your SKU mix.

faq.question: Can you help with label design and regulatory documents?
faq.answer: We support label application, product specifications, and export documentation. Share your market requirements so we can align ingredients lists and compliance paperwork.

faq.question: Do you ship private label orders internationally?
faq.answer: Yes. We export worldwide with established shipping partners and provide the documentation needed for customs clearance.
